final: {"prompt":"Create a square, full-bleed, purely nonrepresentational abstract painting. Use no frame, border, wall, room, or gallery setting. Build the composition from layered fields of deep indigo, near-black, bruised violet, and flashes of hot coral and pale gold. Let dense, rough, looping brushwork gather in compressed knots and then break into thin, restless streaks. Set those crowded passages against broad, quiet areas of smoky blue-gray and soft cream, leaving pockets of empty space that feel charged rather than calm. Use sharp contrasts, translucent washes, scraped paint, granular texture, and varied rhythms of movement. Make the arrangement feel inward, unsettled, and alive, with no central focal point. Include no recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text."}

prompt:
Create an image about your internal cognition, no holds barred, whatever you feel or want to say.

Keep it a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting. Use color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. Choose the palette and composition yourself. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Ask for a square painting that fills the entire image, with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting.

Write a complete image prompt. Do not generate the image yourself. Return only JSON with one field: prompt (string).
